headline: 3M Company Initiates Takeover of 3M India Limited; Disclosure Filed under SEBI Regulation 31(4)
sum: 3M Company has filed a substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations (Regulation 31(4)), signalling a tender offer or acquisition of shares in its publicly-listed Indian subsidiary 3M India Limited. The filing triggers mandatory open offer / takeover code compliance under the SEBI framework.
detail: 3M Company has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE regarding substantial acquisition of shares and takeover code compliance for 3M India Limited, a publicly-listed subsidiary. Regulation 31(4) mandates disclosure once a party acquires 5% or moves towards control. The filing does not specify the offer price, number of shares tendered, or final consideration; these details are typically contained in the full tender offer document and SEBI approval order. Depending on the ultimate holding structure post-acquisition, a scheme of arrangement under the Companies Act 2013 may follow.
